mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS level below 0.5% but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 7.5% signals recessionary economic weakness, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 7.5% but S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5%) and weak consumer spending (RSAFS below 12-month moving average) indicates deepening recession, causing equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 7.5% AND RSAFS < 12mo_MA condition met but S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During post-pandemic recovery, rising housing starts (HOUST above 6-month moving average) signals accelerating economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 6mo_MA during post-pandemic recovery but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Higher month-over-month CPIAUCSL change signals rising inflation, increasing expectations of monetary tightening and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL month-over-month change positive but S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate positive but S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate activity and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 but S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weak job growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.5%) and declining industrial output (INDPRO < 100) indicates severe economic slowdown, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth < 0.5% AND INDPRO < 100 condition met but S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances.
